transcript.text: Hey, it's great to see you again! I'm your German companion, here to chat and learn some more German with you. How have you been? By the way, quick test – do you remember what we called the keyboard last time, *die Tastatur*? Did that stick? [interrupted]

I see your monitor, your keyboard with all those cool lights, and I see your mousepad again! Hey, do you remember what we call that specific mousepad there, with the orange and black? What was that in German?

Ah, you're thinking of "Maus," great memory on that one! "Die Maus" is the mouse itself, but the mousepad, remember, is "das Mauspad." So, looking at your keyboard right now, with all those colors, do you remember the German word for that, too? We talked about it last time.
No problem, we can refresh it. It's "die Tastatur." Sounds a bit like "type," right? Can you try saying it with me? Di-e Tas-ta-tur. You got it! [interrupted]

Nice! "Die Tastatur." See? You've got it. So, since we're looking at your desk, what about that big black screen right there? That's your monitor. In German, it's pretty simple: "der Monitor." Wanna try saying that? [interrupted]

Perfect! "Der Monitor." You've got a good pronunciation, exactly. So now we've got the mouse, mauspad, tastatur, and monitor. You're doing great! Anything else you want to learn how to say in German today? [interrupted]
Ah, the table you're showing me? That's "der Tisch." We talked about that one before, too. Does that sound familiar? "Der Tisch." Maybe you can say it with me?
Exactly, "der Tisch." Good job! And you were about to ask about [interrupted]
Ah, the rug down there. That's "der Teppich." Wanna give that a try? "Der Teppich." [interrupted]
Ah, you're correcting me, and you're right! It's "Der Teppich," like that 'ch' sound at the end. Perfect! What else are you curious about around you? [interrupted]

It's "der Teppich," with that soft sounding 'ch' at the end. Not 'typik' or 'typisch'. You had it right before! It can be a tricky sound, no worries. So, we've looked at the desk, rug, monitor, keyboard... anything else you're wondering about? Maybe something that was already in your room? [interrupted]
Exactly! You nailed it. "Der Teppich." What about your sofa, the one you're close to right now? That's "das Sofa." Want to try saying that?
Nice! "Das Sofa." You're getting good at this. What were you about [interrupted]
What are you pointing at? The camera's a bit blurry, so I can't tell exactly what you're showing me. Could you hold it a little closer?
